summary: Top discussion signals: OpenAI agent deprecation, Google agent platform design, Microsoft persistent Copilot agents, several operator security/workflow reports, and emerging infra primitives (MCP templates, evals, sandbox runtimes). | Vendor-side agent/platform updates and several high-severity infra advisories: Foundry, AWS Quick, OpenRouter and Cursor incidents, plus three GHSA infra vulnerabilities. | GitHub snapshot: major vendor releases (NVIDIA, Anthropic, Google) plus high‑traction agent platforms and infra primitives (orchestration, memory, routing). No social/user-field reports in this shard — see gaps. | Package-shard sweep: mix of vendor extensions (VS Code/Open-VSX, Grafana, BrowserStack, Vercel) and infra primitives (agent custody, sandbox creds, agent detectors, eval tooling). No social/operator reports in this shard — follow-up needed.
